gloss: to exaggerate a story; to embellish

definitions.gloss: to exaggerate a story; to embellish; to make something sound more impressive
definitions.explanation: To add extra details or dramatic elements to a story to make it more interesting or impressive than what actually happened. Common in casual conversation, especially among younger speakers.

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{話|はなし}を{盛|も}ってるでしょう。
⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{話|はなし}を{盛|も}った⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{話|はなし}を{盛|も}る⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧くらい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: He always exaggerates, so you should only take about half of what he says seriously.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧{話|はなし}を{盛|も}る⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: On social media, there are a lot of people who embellish their stories.

notes:
A casual, modern expression meaning to exaggerate or embellish when telling a story. The verb ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ here comes from the idea of "piling on" or "heaping up" — adding more than what actually happened. Very common in everyday conversation, particularly among younger people.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話|はなし}を{盛|も}りすぎる: to exaggerate too much
- ⟦{盛|も}った→盛る：00292_moru⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an exaggerated story
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦{盛|も}っ→盛る：00292_moru⟧てない？: aren't you exaggerating a bit?
- ⟦{盛|も}っ→盛る：00292_moru⟧てるでしょ: you're exaggerating, right?

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in an exaggerated way — more neutral, less playful than ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧
- ⟦{誇張|こちょう}する→誇張する：22148_kochousuru⟧: to exaggerate — formal, used in writing and academic contexts
- ⟦{尾|お}ひれをつける→尾ひれをつける：28672_ohirewotsukeru⟧: to add embellishments — older expression with the same meaning, literally "to add fins and tail"

REGISTER:
Informal and colloquial. Common in spoken Japanese, texting, and social media. Would feel out of place in formal writing or business settings, where ⟦{誇張|こちょう}する→誇張する：22148_kochousuru⟧ is preferred.
